gaps.sentence: I'll take the job ___ they don't offer me any more money.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a future possibility that will not change the decision.

gaps.sentence: ___ being remarkably fast, the new chip consumes far less power.
gaps.explanation: 'Besides + -ing' adds a further advantage; 'despite of' does not exist.

gaps.sentence: The lecture was dull; ___, the students stayed awake out of politeness.
___ his age, he still plays football every week.
gaps.explanation: 'Despite his age' — noun phrase after despite.

gaps.sentence: Please complete the form in block capitals ___ it can be read easily.
gaps.explanation: 'So that' introduces a clause with subject and modal; so as to/in order to need an infinitive.

gaps.sentence: ___ the north coast is rocky, the southern beaches are soft golden sand.
gaps.explanation: 'While' can contrast two clauses in a single sentence.

gaps.sentence: ___ his salary, he earns royalties from three textbooks.
gaps.explanation: 'In addition to + noun' adds one source of income to another.

gaps.sentence: He works as a waiter ___ studying for his degree.
gaps.explanation: 'While' joins two ongoing actions; 'during' takes a noun.
